pivot_note: the bun (old rig's spine pivot); the same pivot as every girl sheet
draw_order: draw order: lower, upper (torso + left arm), arm_right_<state> (the flashlight is drawn over its arm), head (a girl_head_poses frame at head_offset, or girl_sprint_head)
plays_over: girl_pray_loop_lower only (frame 0; she is still, the boots don't move, so there is no bead lower)
trigger_note: start only from pray_loop_calm frame 0 (held) and return to it: both bead frames are built on it (everything above row 128 = held). Not from mid-breath calm frames or pray_loop_afraid (a pop).
clip_note: bead step (option B2): draw = the joined hands and the pinched torch draw back 1 px (one finger row fewer shows under the head); click = they push 1 px forward and her thumb (2 px #7a5c3a) slides out on the palm seam with 2 seam px ahead of it. Cuffs, torso, head and boots = the held frame.
pray_rules: Beti PRAY RULES: hands joined palm to palm in front of her chest, just ahead of the head; in off and on the torch is pinched between them pointing at the floor ahead (one look for both); in none the hands are joined with no torch; kneel boots option B.
head: no head sheet: draw girl_head_poses frame 2 (0 deg, the idle head) moved by head_offset (= the loop's held frame)
